The first draft initiated by eng. Hassan Moussa Hassan, tested by eng. Ramadan Farrag Ahmad, reviewed by: eng. Mohamed Nasr El-Din, and approved by eng. A work permit must be issued.

Wear the personal safety and healthy protective equipment as safety shoes, helmet, ...etc
Maintenance is carried out in cooperation with the mechanical department.

Avometer

Work to be Carried Out
Switch off the passenger elevator supply from the MCC room and from the elevator room.
Using vaccum cleaner to clean the motors filter and modules` cabinet.
Turn on the supply of the elevator from mcc & elevator room.
Change the control mode to "inspection" from the switch on the top of the car.
Review all limit & magnetic switches on the car and their cams inside the elevator pit for all floors visually and adjust their position if needed.
Change the control mode to "normal" from the switch on the car.
Test open & close all doors in all floors automatically.
Check the setting of the photocell and adjust it if necessary.
Reviewing all motors & the lighting of the car is carried out by general auxiliries department.
Test calling the car in all floors.
Put the elevator in service.

uncertain_terms.note: The source document is largely in English already (mixed Arabic headings and English body); the English source text is kept verbatim and only the Arabic parts were translated.
Header table reads 'القوة المحطة' / 'التقنية الإجراء' – garbled; rendered as 'Power Station' / 'Technical Procedure' by inference from the MPIS header pattern.
Source 'on an annually bases' kept verbatim; 'bases' is presumably a typo for 'basis'.

Source 'فئة الأمان المناسبة للهوية' is garbled (literally 'the suitable safety category of the identity'); rendered as 'suitable safety category card' by inference from the standard wording used in the other documents.

Step 1 reads 'قم بإيقاف تشغيل العرض مصعد ركاب من غرفة MCC ومن غرفة المصاعد' – 'العرض' is unclear in this context; rendered as 'Switch off the passenger elevator supply from the MCC room and from the elevator room.'
'مراجعة ضبط الخلية الكهروضوئية وربطه إذا لزم الأمر' rendered as 'Check the setting of the photocell and adjust it if necessary.'; 'وربطه' literally means 'and fasten/tighten it'.
'التعيين' in the footer rendered as 'Designation'; the intended field label is unclear.
